implemented_shadow_only: Added an ExternalMonotonicAnchorReceipt binding anchor_seq, ledger_head_hash, mission/step, installation/runtime, durability_domain_id and previous_anchor_hash.
Anchor bootstrap is allowed only for an empty ledger; a nonempty ledger cannot be retroactively blessed by creating an anchor.
Verification distinguishes LEDGER_ROLLBACK_DETECTED, UNANCHORED_LEDGER_ADVANCE, LEDGER_ANCHOR_FORK_DETECTED and ANCHOR_MATCH.
Anchored append is serialized by an atomic directory-creation writer lock. A second writer fails closed and an abandoned lock is never auto-stolen.
The ledger advances first and the anchor advances only after accepted append; a crash window leaving the ledger ahead fails closed and is never auto-reconciled locally.
Anchor/lock maintenance has zero Experience, zero operational progress, zero formal mutation authority and zero live routing authority.
